findings.text: The company status is recorded as 'liquidation'.

The accounts are overdue; they were next due 30 November 2025 and were last made up to 29 February 2024.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 11 November 2025 and is next due 25 November 2026.
Two charges are registered and outstanding, with none part-satisfied or satisfied.
The company was incorporated on 9 February 2022 and has one current officer, a director appointed on 7 November 2025.
Since 24 October 2025, one officer appointment and one resignation were filed, both dated 7 November 2025.
One registered office address change was filed since 24 October 2025, dated 1 April 2026.

headline.text: The company is in liquidation following a creditors voluntary liquidation, with the accounts overdue and two outstanding charges registered.
